question: In how many regular-season games from 2015-16 to 2022-23 did the winning team trail by 10 or more points at some point in the game, out of how many games with play-by-play?
answer:
In regular-season games from 2015-16 to 2022-23, the winning team successfully overcame a deficit of 10 or more points to win in **2,223** games, out of **8,670** regular-season games with play-by-play data (a **25.6%** comeback rate). 

### Double-Digit Comeback Wins by Season (Regular Season)

| Season | Games with Play-by-Play ($n$) | Trailed by 10+ and Won | Comeback Win % |
| :--- | :---: | :---: | :---: |
| 2015-16 | 1,121 | 241 | 21.5% |
| 2016-17 | 1,129 | 293 | 26.0% |
| 2017-18 | 1,128 | 279 | 24.7% |
| 2018-19 | 1,122 | 294 | 26.2% |
| 2019-20 | 963 | 258 | 26.8% |
| 2020-21 | 988 | 251 | 25.4% |
| 2021-22 | 1,113 | 296 | 26.6% |
| 2022-23 | 1,106 | 311 | 28.1% |
| **Total** | **8,670** | **2,223** | **25.6%** |

### Caveats & Context
* **Missing Play-by-Play:** This analysis is based on the 8,670 regular-season games with fully-logged play-by-play (PBP) events. About 9% of all games across these seasons are missing detailed play-by-play logs in the database and are excluded.
* **Shortened Seasons:** The 2019-20 and 2020-21 regular seasons have fewer games logged due to COVID-19 schedule reductions, but the percentage of double-digit comeback wins remained in line with other years. 
* **Entire Game vs. Clutch Time:** This query captures 10+ point deficits at any point from the opening tip to the final buzzer. It does not isolate "clutch time," which is defined in this database as the final 5 minutes of the 4th quarter or overtime when the score margin is within 5 points.

args.query: winning team trail by 10 or more regular season games count

{"examples": [{"id": "team_clutch_record", "question": "What is each team's win-loss record in games that had clutch time (2022-23 regular season)?", "sql": "SELECT t.team, COUNT(*) AS clutch_games, SUM((g.winner = t.team)::INT) AS wins,
       COUNT(*) - SUM((g.winner = t.team)::INT) AS losses,
       ROUND(100.0 * SUM((g.winner = t.team)::INT) / COUNT(*), 1) AS win_pct
FROM team_game_clutch t JOIN games g USING (game_id)
WHERE t.season_start_year = 2022 AND t.season_type = 'Regular Season'
GROUP BY t.team
ORDER BY win_pct DESC, clutch_games DESC
LIMIT 10"}, {"id": "team_clutch_net", "question": "Which teams outscore opponents the most in clutch time (2022-23 regular season)?", "sql": "SELECT team, COUNT(*) AS clutch_games, SUM(clutch_pts_for) AS pts_for, SUM(clutch_pts_against) AS pts_against,
       SUM(clutch_pts_for - clutch_pts_against) AS net_pts,
       ROUND(AVG(clutch_pts_for - clutch_pts_against), 2) AS net_per_game
FROM team_game_clutch
WHERE season_start_year = 2022 AND season_type = 'Regular Season'
GROUP BY team
ORDER BY net_pts DESC
LIMIT 10"}, {"id": "comeback_rate_by_season", "question": "How often do teams come back from double-digit deficits to win, by season (regular season)?", "sql": "SELECT season_label, COUNT(*) AS games, SUM(comeback_10::INT) AS wins_after_trailing_10,
       ROUND(100.0 * SUM(comeback_10::INT) / COUNT(*), 1) AS pct_10,
       SUM(comeback_20::INT) AS wins_after_trailing_20,
       ROUND(100.0 * SUM(comeback_20::INT) / COUNT(*), 2) AS pct_20
FROM game_swings
WHERE season_type = 'Regular Season'
GROUP BY season_label ORDER BY season_label"}]}

args.query:
SELECT 
    COUNT(*) AS total_games_pbp,
    SUM(CASE WHEN comeback_10 = TRUE THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS comeback_10_flag,
    SUM(CASE WHEN winner_max_deficit >= 10 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS deficit_10_or_more,
    ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN comeback_10 = TRUE THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 2) AS pct_comeback
FROM game_swings
WHERE season_type = 'Regular Season'
  AND season_start_year >= 2015 
  AND season_start_year <= 2022;

SELECT 
    season_label,
    COUNT(*) AS total_games,
    SUM(CASE WHEN winner_max_deficit >= 10 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS trailed_by_10_plus,
    ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN winner_max_deficit >= 10 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 2) AS comeback_pct
FROM game_swings
WHERE season_type = 'Regular Season'
  AND season_start_year >= 2015 
  AND season_start_year <= 2022
GROUP BY season_label
ORDER BY season_label;
